component: TPI LAZARUS U-Boot 2024.04 SATA UEFI v3.7
recorded_by: TPI bring-up host (Dell Wyse 3040, Debian 13), UART 115200 8N1, driven remotely over Tailscale

deployment.storage: eMMC GPT partition uboot, LBA 16384, 8192 sectors
deployment.transport: rockusb gadget provided by the build itself, driven remotely
deployment.layout: two identical FIT copies at 0x000000 and 0x200000
deployment.replaced: v3.6, sha256 20dbee4b179be724ee97c72183573fae103024856010c198e1040e44bf4434da, saved on the bring-up host before the write

pre_flight.method: loaded the chainload image from the SATA ext4 partition into RAM and jumped to it before touching eMMC
pre_flight.note: loading straight to 0x00a00000 is refused with 'Reading file would overwrite reserved memory', so the image goes to a scratch address first
pre_flight.observed: the new build printed its banner and carried the board through UEFI, GRUB 2.12 and Linux without writing anything to eMMC

boot_chain_observed: Forlinx MiniLoader verified all nine FIT components, including optee at 0x08400000
TF-A BL31 v2.3 started OP-TEE 3.13.0 as BL32, 'Using opteed sec cpu_context!'
AHCI 6 Gbps, SCSI Device 0: ATA P3-128 119.2 GB
UEFI boot manager loaded BOOTAA64.EFI from the SATA ESP, GRUB 2.12 started

ethernet.status: works in U-Boot and in Linux
uboot: ethernet@fe2a0000 (unconnected port) TIMEOUT, phy_startup() failed: -110, U-Boot falls back on its own
ethernet@fe010000 Waiting for PHY auto negotiation to complete....... done
DHCP client bound to address 192.168.10.36 (275 ms)
ethernet.linux: eth1 up with a DHCP lease, board reachable over the LAN and over Tailscale

ums.command: ums 0 mmc 0 at the TPI-LAZARUS=> prompt
observed: host enumerated the board as a 29.1 GB USB disk, model 'UMS disk 0'
the host read the GPT over USB and listed all eight eMMC partitions with matching labels and sizes: uboot 4M, misc 4M, boot 64M, recovery 128M, backup 32M, rootfs 6G, oem 128M, userdata 22.8G
Ctrl+C returned the console and the USB disk disappeared

rollback: interrupt autoboot, run rockusb 0 mmc 0 and write a saved backup with rkdeveloptool write-partition uboot
changes_since_v3_6: CONFIG_IDENT_STRING emptied: the U-Boot version line no longer repeats 'TPI LAZARUS / Tech Pro Industries LLC', which the banner underneath already carries
device tree model shortened to 'TPI LAZARUS UVON'; the SoM name stays in compatible and on the banner's SoC line, and Linux now reports that model as its DMI product name
the T, P and i of the TPI mark moved onto the front face of the ASCII cube; the top and right faces are left clean

build_fit.py carries the release version in a single VERSION constant, and the build directory and both vendor inputs can be pointed elsewhere with TPI_BUILD_DIR, TPI_VENDOR_UEFI_FIT and TPI_VENDOR_UBOOT_FIT; the SHA-256 checks on those inputs are unchanged

verified_after_change.note: nothing outside the console strings and the device tree model property was touched, so the image differs from v3.7's predecessor only in BL33

'Model: TPI LAZARUS UVON' with no SoM suffix
banner cube prints '|   T P i  |  |' on its front face
scsi scan found the 119.2 GB disk, dhcp bound in 275 ms, ums exported all eight partitions
